issues_found.title: wetext 文本规范化前端间歇性加载失败，导致服务启动失败
issues_found.root_cause: wetext.Normalizer.__init__ 无条件调用 modelscope.snapshot_download('pengzhendong/wetext')；CosyVoice frontend.py:78-85 连续构造 ZhNormalizer 与 EnNormalizer，背靠背两次 snapshot_download 触发 ModelScope 匿名限流，第二次返回 HTTP 403 (Authentication token does not exist)，异常被 except 吞掉后 text_frontend 置空
issues_found.evidence: 首次运行：/revisions 200 -> /revisions 403 -> 'no frontend is avaliable' -> 被 api/services/tts.py:240 TextFrontendUnavailable 拦截；单独调用 snapshot_download 复测 0.8s 成功，确认是间歇性限流
issues_found.impact: 服务启动成功率依赖外部限流状态；若 R14 fail-fast 被移除则退化为静默不规范化（数字原样朗读）
